title: Overseas remittance firm Eninepay reportedly hacked, 약 25억원 taken, Etnews reports
date_note: Etnews' article of 27 November gives no earlier date for the hack; the date is the article's publication day.
summary: Etnews reports in an exclusive that Eninepay, described as South Korea's first small-amount overseas remittance company, was hacked and 약 25억원 of customer funds was taken. Segye Ilbo and Asia Economy report that the Financial Supervisory Service sent an on-site inspection team on 27 November to establish the scale of damage and how it happened, and that financial authorities are still confirming the exact amount. Neither gives a company statement.
